IncBot: :rotating_light: ALERT: sustained queue growth and 5xx spike on /v1/generate in us-east-1. 5xx rate 2.2% -> 10.6% over 7m, p95 latency x4. Paging @Priya (oncall).
Priya (oncall): joining. pulling traces and recent deploys. anyone see scheduler churn or large-req bursts?
Marco (runtime): no deploys. Telemetry shows many concurrent streaming requests from partner-key: partner-omega (long lived SSE connections). They opened ~1200 concurrent streams with avg duration ~45s. max_in_flight for pool rpool-us-east-a is 80; queue depth hitting 1400. Kernel timeouts and KV lock contention observed.
Jenna (SRE): that explains head-of-line blocking. Quick mitigations: 1) apply per-key concurrency cap for partner-omega, 2) reduce per-pool max_in_flight to relieve head-of-line, 3) enable aggressive admission control for streaming endpoints, 4) consider toggling streaming->polling fallback for free/anonymous.
Riley (prodeng): also want to preserve paid customer SLAs. Plan: - cap partner-omega to 50 concurrent streaming requests, - set rpool-us-east-a max_in_flight -> 36, - enable streaming admission: reject >1 long-poll per key with 429, - set server soft timeout for streaming handshake to 10s, - disable nonessential heavy post-processing (rerank + syntax-check) on shared pools.
Priya (oncall): execute. Marco, you own runtime changes. Jenna, apply gateway/per-key limits and throttles. CS-Liaison prepare outreach for any impacted customers of partner-omega. I'll monitor metrics.
Marco (runtime): applying runtime config now: `runtimectl patch pool rpool-us-east-a --set max_in_flight=36 --set streaming.admission.enabled=true --set streaming.max_conn_per_key=1`
Marco (runtime): done. max_in_flight=36 applied. immediate decrease in queue length ~46% within 40s. GPU busy time down from 97% to 78%.
Jenna (SRE): gateway: `gwctl throttle add --key partner-omega --concurrency 50 --region us-east-1` and `gwctl rate-limit set --scope streaming --region us-east-1 --limit 200rps` applying.
Jenna (SRE): gateway changes live. Observing drop in streaming ingress and fewer long-tail connections. Also added rule to return `Retry-After` header for 429s to help client backoff.
CS-Liaison: partner-omega PM pinged via support channel; they reported increased retries from their SDK. I've asked them to apply SDK backoff and will escalate if needed. Opening ticket INC-2109.
Marco (runtime): enabling streaming->polling fallback for anonymous/free keys: `feature-toggle set fallback.streaming_to_polling true --scope free` -> enabled. This should reduce long-lived occupancy from non-paid keys.
Riley (prodeng): disabling rerank+synth-check for shared pool: `ff-toggle set rerank false --pool rpool-us-east-a` and `ff-toggle set syntax-check false --pool rpool-us-east-a` -> done. CPU load and extra GPU kernels dropped.
Priya (oncall): early metrics 15m post: 5xx down to 1.9%, median latency back to 1.3x baseline. Some partner-omega requests now 429/ok with Retry-After; overall good. Any remaining paid customer impact?
CS-Liaison: two paying customers reported transient slow responses earlier but not in last 10m. No open escalations. Partner-omega acknowledged limits and will stagger streams.
Jenna (SRE): note: autoscaler didn't keep up because scale-up cooldown is 3m; proposing cooldown shorten and burst capacity rule for streaming spikes. Creating infra ticket INFRA-1158.
Marco (runtime): follow-up: root cause appears to be partner's SDK change enabling persistent streaming per conversation which multiplied connections. We'll add admission-based prioritization: heavy features and streaming will be deprioritized for non-enterprise keys. Also will add cost-weighting for request types to admission controller.
Riley (prodeng): long-term: add explicit routing for streaming jobs to a separate streaming-optimized pool with different admission limits. I'll draft PRD.
Priya (oncall): handoff: Marco will monitor metrics for 60m, Jenna will own gateway rules and infra ticket, Riley will own product routing work, CS-Liaison will follow up with partner and affected customers. If 5xx >5% re-page.
Marco (runtime): set temporary alert: queue_depth>500 OR 5xx>4% -> page oncall.
Priya (oncall): documenting mitigation steps and timeline in incident tracker. Good work. I'm handing monitoring to Marco; I'm stepping off in 45m.
IncBot: Incident annotated: per-key cap, max_in_flight reduced, streaming admission enabled, feature toggles applied. Severity downgraded to P2.
Priya (oncall): closing thread for now; will add post-incident RCA items after stabilization. :thumbsup:
